checks.instructions: On a native keyboard and mouse, exercise WASD movement, Space jump, Shift sprint, mouse look, wheel and 1-9 selection, middle-click picking, E help, Escape pause/resume and F fullscreen. Check cursor capture and focus changes. Record the OS and actual input devices.

On an actual native gamepad, use both sticks, A jump, held L3 sprint, held B crouch, RT mining, LT placing, LB/RB material selection, X/R3 picking, Y/View guide, D-pad up/down checkpoint save/load and Start pause. Verify menu navigation, focus loss and reconnect do not leak actions into play. Record controller model and OS; synthetic mappings do not certify the device.

Confirm mouse right turns right and mouse up looks up. Walk and jump beside blocks; inspect camera height, collision, target outline and crosshair alignment. Check hotbar and help readability at the intended window sizes. Record the display and renderer.

Break a targeted block with left click and place each palette material with right click. Check reach, adjacent-face placement, solid-block collision and protection against placing inside the player. Save with F5, change the world and position, then load with F9 and confirm the saved edits and player state return.

Listen on an actual output device to the quiet original piano-and-pad music over several minutes and its loop transition. Mine/place different materials, walk and land; confirm subtle material cues, comfortable mix, separate music/effects toggles and persistence across relaunch. Record hardware and what was heard; software metrics and playback counters leave hardware listening pending.

Start a fresh world and confirm there is no prebuilt house. Explore beyond x/z 0 and 64 in both directions; confirm continuous terrain, trees, rendering and collision. Edit blocks across a chunk border, travel away, return, save and restart; verify builds persist. Load an old checkpoint and confirm its original blocks survive.
